item.title: 44k-Mile 2015 Mercedes-Benz G63 AMG
item.description: This 2015 Mercedes-Benz G63 AMG is finished in Dakota Brown Metallic over Designo Sand and black leather upholstery and has 44k miles following history in Colorado and Florida. item.title: Original-Owner 1986 Ford Mustang GT Convertible 5-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1986 Ford Mustang GT convertible was purchased new out of Santa Monica, California, by the seller, who has registered it in that state as well as in Georgia, Idaho, and Arizona and daily-drove it from 1986 to 1991. The car is powered by a 302ci Windsor V8 paired with a five-speed manual transmission and a Traction-Lok limited-slip differential, and it is finished in Bright Red over Canyon Red cloth. item.title: 2021 BMW Alpina XB7
item.description: This 2021 BMW Alpina XB7 was initially delivered to Braman BMW of Miami, Florida, and was optioned with second-row captain’s chairs, a rear-seat entertainment system, and a Bowers & Wilkins sound system. It is finished in Arctic Grey Metallic over black Merino leather, while power is provided by a twin-turbocharged 4.4-liter V8 mated to an Alpina-tuned eight-speed automatic transmission and xDrive all-wheel drive. item.title: 1966 Jaguar E-Type Roadster
item.description: This 1966 Jaguar XKE Series I roadster was restored by Kolorworks of Asbury Park, New Jersey, between 1993 and 1994, and a subsequent refresh completed in 2014 included the replacement of chassis and mechanical components. Powered by a 4.2-liter inline-six linked to a four-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential, the car is finished in British Racing Green over tan leather. item.title: Amethyst Metallic 1994 Porsche 911 Turbo 3.6
item.description: This 1994 Porsche 911 Turbo 3.6 is one of a reported 754 examples produced for the model year, and it was optioned in Amethyst Metallic over Classic Gray partial leather. Power comes from a turbocharged 3.6-liter flat-six paired with a five-speed manual transaxle, and equipment includes cruise control, a fixed rear spoiler, a power sunroof, power-adjustable front seats, and a PCCM infotainment system. item.description: This Shelby is a CSX6000 continuation model that was ordered by the current owner via Hillbank Motor Corporation as a rolling chassis in 2020. item.title: 2025 Porsche 911 GT3 RS Weissach
item.description: This 2025 Porsche 911 GT3 RS was optioned with a front-axle lift, Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes, a Bose sound system, and the weight-reducing Weissach Package. Power is provided by a 4.0-liter flat-six that drives the rear wheels through a seven-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic transaxle and an electronically locking differential. item.title: Ex–Vic Edelbrock Jr., 292 Flathead-Powered 1932 Ford Roadster by Roy Brizio
item.description: This 1932 Ford roadster was built by Vic Edelbrock Jr. and Roy Brizio in the early 2000s as a tribute to Vic Edelbrock's Old No. 3 hot rod. The original '32 was a record-setting car that was piloted by Edelbrock Sr. to 121.45 mph at Harper's Dry Lake in November 1941. Nearly 60 years later, Edelbrock Jr. commissioned Roy Brizio to rebuild an original 1932 Roadster as a tribute to his father’s achievement at a total cost in excess of $200k.
